items.title: 初次见面
items.text: …谢谢你的支持，签名的后面需要什么图案？一片羽毛可以吗？噢，不是粉丝。看来是我误会了。重新自我介绍一下，奥黛塔，至冬科洛列夫茨基剧团的芭蕾舞者…依旧谢谢你的支持。
items.text_en: ...Thanks for all the support. You want an autograph, right? What do you want me to draw next to it? How about a feather? Oh, wait, you're not one of my fans? Guess I misunderstood. Lemme start from the top, then. I'm Odette, a ballerina with the Korolevskiy Troupe... Well, thanks for all the support, anyway.

items.title: 闲聊·忙碌
items.text: 如果没有别的事情的话，我先去练习舞蹈了。
items.text_en: Well, if that's all, I'm going to go rehearse.

items.title: 闲聊·简单
items.text: 能简单回应的事情，不需要长篇大论。
items.text_en: If a simple response will do, why waste your breath on anything longer?

items.title: 闲聊·时间
items.text: 时间能变成双倍…不，三倍就好了。
items.text_en: If only there were double the hours in a day... Hmm. Actually, make that triple.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 雨滴落下时淅淅沥沥的声音总能让我感到平静，这样的天气很适合独自练舞。
items.text_en: The pitter-patter of the raindrops always makes me feel so serene. This kind of weather is perfect for dancing alone.

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 平静而美好的时刻总是短暂的。
items.text_en: The most beautiful, serene moments are always the most fleeting.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 至冬的雪，向来冷得刺骨，又永无尽头。
items.text_en: The snow in Snezhnaya is always bitterly cold, and it never seems to end.

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 发型…等一下再重新梳理吧。
items.text_en: My hair... I'll fix it later.

items.title: 在沙漠的时候
items.text: …还好不会在这种地方开见面会。
items.text_en: ...At least there wouldn't be a meet-and-greet in a place like this.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 我已经热身完毕，随时可以行动。
items.text_en: I'm warmed up and ready to go.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 我不需要午睡，午后这种不适合训练的时间，我通常会看看舞剧剧本。嗯？你问这些信纸吗？是沃雅妮莎塞给我的粉丝来信，她要我好好看完。
items.text_en: I'm not one for naps. Noon isn't a suitable time for training either, so I usually spend it reading through the scripts for our dance dramas. Hm? What about these letters? They're from my fans. Vodyanitsa practically forced them into my hand. She wants me to read through them for once.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 晚饭时间到了吗？等下就要登台，吃一个煮鸡蛋就够了，等今晚演出全部结束之后，再随便吃点吧。
items.text_en: Oh, is it time for dinner? I have to go on stage soon, so I'll just have a hard-boiled egg. I'll grab something else once the show's over.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: …任务完成，训练量达标，新舞蹈也练习完毕。表情管理有些不足，还需要再对着镜子调整一下…已经到这个时间了吗？你先休息吧，我还有安排。
items.text_en: ...Missions complete, training quota met, new routine fully rehearsed. Not satisfied with my facial expressions, though. I need to practice some more in front of the mirror... Oh, is it that late already? Feel free to retire. I still have things to do.

items.title: 关于奥黛塔自己·呼啸社
items.text: 完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情严冬计划推行后，来剧院看演出的观众越来越少了。大家的生活已经跌入困境，更有危害民众的蛀虫，对此我无法无动于衷。我知道仅凭一己之力无法扭转局势，但我仍想做一些力所能及的事情。
items.text_en: Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"Since the implementation of Project Stuzha, the size of our audience has been dwindling. While most people are struggling to get by, corrupt leeches continue to prey on the public. I refuse to turn a blind eye. I know I can't turn the tide on my own, but I still want to do what I can.

items.title: 关于奥黛塔自己·记性
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启以前的记忆一直烙印在脑海中，在夜深人静的时候，像映影一样反复播放…记性太好不是好事。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The memories of my past are forever etched into my mind. Like a film, they play on repeat in the dead of night... Suffice to say, having a perfect memory isn't always a good thing.

items.title: 关于我们·寄托
items.text: 来自他人的保护就像刚刚凝结而成的薄冰一样，是十分脆弱的东西，我不会把希望寄托在别人身上。
items.text_en: Relying on others for protection is like leaning on a thin layer of fresh ice. I don't pin my hopes on anyone but myself.

items.title: 关于我们·伤口
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启我对痛觉的感受很迟钝，等我察觉伤口时，伤口已经结痂了。这样也好。无论是练习舞蹈还是接受愚人众特训，都不会因为身体状况耽误我的日程。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6My sense of pain is quite dull. I often don't even notice I'm injured until the wound has already started to scab over. But, I prefer it that way. Whether it's dance rehearsal or Fatui special training, it's better if a trivial thing like my physical condition doesn't get in the way.

items.title: 关于「星之楔」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启以前，在一次训练中，极寒冻伤了我的腿脚，让我近乎失去知觉，最后是在「星之楔」散发出的亮光中醒来的。不过从没有听说「星之楔」能将人唤醒的传闻，当时醒来是因为…我本能地想要活下去吗…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Once, during an intense training session, I developed frostbite in my feet and legs due to the extreme cold, and almost lost consciousness entirely. When I came to, the first thing I noticed was a bright light emanating from the Stellar Linchpin in front of me. But, I've never heard of Stellar Linchpins being able to awaken people like that. So if that didn't wake me up... then maybe it was some instinctual desire to survive...?

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 每一次彩排，我都会当作正式演出一样认真对待。
items.text_en: I treat every rehearsal as seriously as an actual performance.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 有些冰醋栗吃起来不够甜，只要撒一些细盐，就会变得香甜好吃了。据说是有了咸味的衬托，甜味就会被放大。一位粉丝告诉我的。
items.text_en: You can bring out the sweetness of Rimecurrants by sprinkling them with a little table salt. Supposedly, the contrast helps amplify their inner sweetness. I heard that from a fan.

items.title: 关于罗莎琳·曾经
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情罗莎琳有恩于我，但我也一度憎恨着她。她的要求非常严苛，在她手下训练的那段时间，挨冻、累倒、受伤与生病都是常有的事情。曾经我天真地想，只要我能独立站上舞台，靠跳芭蕾舞也能养活自己和母亲了，我就离开愚人众给她看。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"I'm indebted to Rosalyne, but there was also a time when I really hated her. She was exacting in her demands and incredibly strict. Freezing from the cold, collapsing from exhaustion, getting injured, falling sick... Those were all common occurrences when I trained under her. I used to harbor this naive dream that I just needed to make it as a ballerina, earn enough to support my mother, and then, one day, I would leave her and the Fatui in the dust...

items.title: 关于罗莎琳·燃珀
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情人不在了，很多话就失去了说出口的意义。「燃珀」砸碎起来是那么容易，却让误会和伤痛显得更加讽刺…为什么事到如今，我们才能互相理解呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"After someone is gone, a lot of things are suddenly no longer worth saying. I could shatter this Cor Ignis in a heartbeat, yet that would make the pain and the misunderstandings it caused feel all the more ridiculous... Why is it only now, after all this time, that we finally understand each other?

items.title: 关于「女皇」陛下
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启「女皇」陛下是全至冬的信仰，她事务繁忙，鲜少露面。我能见到她的次数寥寥无几，她十分庄重威严，她的目光不管落在哪里，都像是万年不化的冰雪一般冰冷但坚定。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Her Majesty the Tsaritsa is Snezhnaya's pillar of faith. Her duties keep her quite occupied, so she rarely makes public appearances. In fact, I've only seen her on a handful of occasions, but she always strikes me as an incredibly regal and solemn figure. No matter where her gaze falls, it is as cold and unwavering as a sheet of ice, one that no amount of time could melt.

items.title: 关于「少女」大人
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启她走路的姿态好像一片羽毛在飘起飘落。任何一位舞者都会羡慕这份轻盈。沃雅妮莎也曾和我聊起过她空灵的歌声。但我们看到与羡慕的，都是她「台前」的模样，我们并不了解真实的她心中是否背负着不为人知的痛苦，不是吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4She walks with an almost feather-light grace that would be the envy of any dancer. According to Vodyanitsa, she also has a hauntingly beautiful singing voice. Although, I suppose what we see and envy is the persona she projects on the surface. Who knows what untold pain lies underneath...

items.title: 关于「仆人」大人
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情壁炉之家的孩子们都将「仆人」大人视为「父亲」。有父亲庇佑的孩子，成长路上总归会少些冰雪风雨。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"The children of the House of the Hearth think of her as their "Father." Hopefully, that will spare them some of the bitter chill and raging storms that life brings. A father's role is to protect, after all.

items.title: 关于「木偶」大人
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启从前罗莎琳参加完「木偶」大人的茶会，心情都会变得比平时更好——虽然要求依旧严苛，但语气明显缓和了许多，任何人都能察觉出来。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Lady Marionette's tea parties always used to put Rosalyne in a better mood. She was just as strict, but her tone was a bit softer. It was quite a noticeable difference.

items.title: 关于沃雅妮莎·微笑
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启第一次「女皇」陛下要来科洛列夫茨基剧团看我们演出的时候，沃雅妮莎提前把这个消息告诉了我，我回答说嗯。结果她伸出食指把我的嘴角提了上去，硬是制造出一个微笑，还要我跟着她一起念：「太、好、了！」我依然不觉得「女皇」陛下喜欢看到那样的笑容。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The first time the Tsaritsa was coming to see one of the Korolevskiy Troupe's performances, Vodyanitsa was the one who told me. I replied with a simple nod of the head. She then proceeded to force a smile onto my face by pushing up both corners of my mouth, then made me repeat after her, "What. Great. News."Perhaps it was practice for appearing in front of the Tsaritsa, but I still don't think Her Majesty appreciates that kind of smile.

items.title: 关于沃雅妮莎·看病
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启沃雅妮莎生病的时候总会缠着我，让我陪着她一起…理由是万一需要打针或者吃苦药的话，她会很害怕的，所以想要紧紧抓住我的胳膊。我的痛觉很不明显，自然也不会甩开她。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Whenever Vodyanitsa gets sick, she always gets so clingy and practically latches herself to my side... She says it's because she's scared of getting a shot or having to take bitter medicine, so she needs something to hold onto, and I suppose my arm is her instrument of choice. I have a high pain tolerance, though, so there's no reason to shake her off.

items.title: 关于阿罗夏
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「死魂灵的夜曲」剧情身为猎户养活自己并不难，但他还是经常来剧院打零工，为了援助那些受苦的人们…我并不奇怪他会加入呼啸社。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Wraith's Nocturne"He could easily make a living on hunting alone if all he cared about was himself, but he still takes on odd jobs around the theater so he can help others who are suffering... I'm not surprised he joined the Rokot.

items.title: 关于米提亚
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启这位…「粉丝」先生，他经常来剧院观看我和沃雅妮莎的表演。但每次表演开始，他都在低着头写些什么，在一众翘首看向舞台的观众中很是醒目。或许他的围巾比他更懂得欣赏演出。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Hm... I suppose you could call him a "fan" of the theater. He comes to see me and Vodyanitsa perform often enough. But as soon as the show starts, he always buries his head in his notes, writing away about goodness knows what. It's hard to ignore, especially when the rest of the audience has their eyes glued to the stage. I wouldn't be surprised if there's more true appreciation for the arts in his scarf than his entire body.

items.title: 关于瓦列里
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启瓦列里少校，一位有着严格时间观念的愚人众军官，听说他总用一种冷静且骇人的态度为同僚安排工作。但我们所属不同所以鲜有交集，而且…我该做的事情并不需要任何人提醒。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Major Valeriy is a Fatui officer who's very strict about keeping things on schedule. I've heard he commands with a level-headed disposition that can also come off as quite terrifying... But we belong to different divisions, so we rarely have a chance to interact. Besides... I don't need anyone to remind me what I should be doing.

items.title: 关于薇斯纳
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启别因为她有对翅膀，就把她当成华丽无害的蝴蝶，那个受人簇拥的家伙是冬契军的总司令，冰雪之中的猎食者。你要擦亮眼睛，别被热情的笑容骗了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Don't be thinking she's some dainty, harmless butterfly just because of those wings. People may flock to her, but she's the commander-in-chief of the Druzhna — one of the fiercest predators on the tundra. Keep your eyes wide open, and don't be fooled by her smile.

items.title: 想要了解奥黛塔·其一
items.text: 我的日程安排比较紧凑，等会儿还有训练。请见谅。要聊天的话，我们长话短说。
items.text_en: You'll have to excuse me. My schedule for the day is quite packed, and I have rehearsal later, so if you want to chat, please keep it brief.

items.title: 想要了解奥黛塔·其二
items.text: 好感等级达到3后开启我的母亲出自芭蕾世家，父亲曾效力愚人众，他们因一次演出而结缘，那是一段能让任何听者都露出笑容的浪漫往事。幼时，母亲会带我一起轻盈地跳舞，父亲会给我买漂亮的新舞裙。我唯一的烦恼是每天到底要从糖果罐子里选择哪一块。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3My mother came from a family of ballet dancers, and my father served in the Fatui. They met after one of her performances and quickly fell in love. It's a sweet story that would bring a smile to anyone's face, I'm sure. When I was little, my days were spent dancing alongside my mother, clad in one of the many beautiful tutus my father would buy for me. I had no worries... except perhaps for which piece of candy to pick from the candy jar each day.

items.title: 想要了解奥黛塔·其三
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启后来父亲因公殉职的噩耗传来，母亲悲痛欲绝，在演出时摔断了腿。糖果罐子里所有的糖都洒了出去，而我被关在了那里面。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Of course, before long, we received the tragic news that my father had died in the line of duty. My mother was devastated and ended up breaking her leg during a performance. Before this, life was sugary-sweet. But now, it felt like the candy jar was empty, and I was trapped inside.

items.title: 想要了解奥黛塔·其四
items.text: 好感等级达到5后开启再后来的事情，你也知道了。这些回忆被我咀嚼了太多次，已经不会再伤害到我了。但对抗命运过程中获得的力量，却是属于我自己的。我不会忘记这一点。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5After that, well... You know what happened. I've unpacked those memories so many times, they can no longer hurt me. Struggling against the hand that fate dealt me... It made me strong, and that strength is mine alone. I won't forget that.

items.title: 想要了解奥黛塔·其五
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启我不想对任何粉丝说这些，好在你不是。我的身份已经太多了，任何一面最好都保持其应有的剔透…我会向着我心中的完美舞下去。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I wouldn't say any of this to my fans, so it's a good thing you're not one. I already have too many versions of myself to maintain, and I prefer for them not to bleed into each other... Of course, in my heart, I will forever keep dancing toward perfection.

items.title: 奥黛塔的爱好
items.text: 从始至终我都很喜欢芭蕾，我会竭尽全力在这个舞台上为观众带来我能跳出的最好的舞蹈。
items.text_en: I've always loved ballet, and I do my utmost to give the best possible performance every time I'm on stage.

items.title: 奥黛塔的烦恼
items.text: 说实话我一直觉得自己不太受小动物欢迎。剧院周围经常有小猫出没，沃雅妮莎会拉着我一起去喂它，我一走过去，小猫就开始磨爪子…嗯？你说那是欢迎我的意思吗？
items.text_en: Honestly, I feel like small animals hate me. Vodyanitsa always makes me go with her to feed the stray cats around the theater, but as soon as I approach, they start sharpening their claws... Hm? That means they're excited to see me? Huh...

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 餐厅快打烊时，会半价出售当天的沙拉，从前有段时间经常吃这个。放久了的沙拉味道当然比不上新鲜的，但因为口感实在熟悉，反倒让人安心。
items.text_en: Right before closing, the salads at the dining hall are half-price, so I used to eat that a lot. Obviously, salads that have been left out all day don't taste as good as fresh ones. But something about the familiarity of it is quite comforting to me.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 从我个人喜好上来说，并没有难以下咽的食物。但作为芭蕾舞者，必须在饮食上保持克制，每日饮食计划外的食物是不推荐吃的。所以我不吃。
items.text_en: To be honest, I don't think there's any food I find particularly unpalatable. But, as a ballet dancer, I have to be strict about my diet, so all of my meals are carefully planned. I tend to avoid anything not included in that.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 这几天演出比较多，或许…不，没什么。谢谢你，这个很美味。
items.text_en: I have had quite a few performances these last few days. Perhaps a little more couldn't... Ahem, never mind. It's delicious. Thank you.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 一道菜？更像…一整天的食物。
items.text_en: This is just one dish? It looks more like... a whole day's worth of food.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 抱歉，我在控制体重。
items.text_en: Uhm, no thank you. I'm watching what I eat.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 生日快乐。不知道你想要怎样的生日礼物？我收到的总是鲜花、舞鞋与音乐盒。但我猜那并不是你的愿望。不如你向我许愿吧，只要是我能实现的。
items.text_en: Happy Birthday! I was trying to think of what to get you... I usually receive things like flowers, ballet shoes, and music boxes, but I doubt that's what you have in mind. How about you simply... make a wish, here and now? Ideally, something within my power to grant, of course...

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 突破等级「1」阶后开启还欠缺了一些什么…再加点训练量好了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Hm, not quite there yet... I need to train even harder.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 突破等级「2」阶后开启嗯，动作更加精准了。保持这样的训练量。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Mm, my movements feel sharper. I should keep up the intensity.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 突破等级「4」阶后开启现在我有信心能够完美地完成鞭转了。不过训练量不能减。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4My fouettés are now perfect. But now is no time to let up.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 突破等级「6」阶后开启「情感也是芭蕾舞不可欠缺的一部分。」现在我能理解它的含义了，谢谢你一直以来的陪伴和支持，今天有我的演出，这是门票。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6"Emotion is an indispensable part of ballet." I now understand what that means. Thank you for your faithful companionship and support. If you're interested in coming to my performance later today, here's a ticket.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 开始了。
items.text_en: Let's begin.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 冰中雪影。
items.text_en: Shadow me.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 起。
items.text_en: Together.

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: 共舞时刻。
items.text_en: Pas de deux.

items.title: 元素战技·其五
items.text: 旋转。
items.text_en: Pirouette.

items.title: 元素战技·其六
items.text: 呵。
items.text_en: Hehe.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 冰封的旋律。
items.text_en: Waltz of the snowflakes.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 镂冰履凌。
items.text_en: Crystalline adagio.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 献上，雪鹄的礼赞。
items.text_en: Witness the snow swan's grace.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 我不需要这些，你收好。
items.text_en: I don't need any of this. You keep it.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 旅途就像练习，每一步都算数。
items.text_en: A journey is a lot like dance practice — every step counts.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 努力的成果。
items.text_en: Hard work pays off.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 不足为意。
items.text_en: Not concerned.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 区区小伤。
items.text_en: Nothing but a scratch.

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 我还可以。
items.text_en: Still good.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 你还好吗？
items.text_en: You alright?

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 换人吧。
items.text_en: Let's switch.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 是我不够努力…
items.text_en: Should have... worked... harder...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 不行，要站起来才对…
items.text_en: No. Gotta... stand... up...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 原来，还能感到疼痛…
items.text_en: So this is... what pain feels like...

items.title: 普通受击·其二
items.text: 然后呢？
items.text_en: Try harder.

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 就这吗？
items.text_en: That's it?

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 不痛不痒。
items.text_en: That supposed to hurt?

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 我准备好了。
items.text_en: At the ready.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 是特邀演出吗？
items.text_en: Need me to take center stage?

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 这次去哪里？
items.text_en: Where to this time?
